about_the_game:
Take the throne and fix the corrupt kingdom— or worsen it! A villainess life simulator and visual novel where you balance your stats and romance rival nations' leaders for foreign policy purposes. Make choices to affect your stats and the entire nation's story. Includes hundreds of manhwa-style artworks hand-drawn by me. How will you rule?

🌟Princess-raising simulator x Country Management x Otome isekai villainess manhwa!

The land of Iriyn is riddled with issues like a stagnant economy, shaky foreign relations, and a dissatisfied public. You can try to fix these, or make it worse for the sake of chasing personal wealth and power. Your choices will determine what happens to the world, and what people say about you. Beware of the 'scandal sheet' newspapers that try to slander you!

Every decision will affect various stats, whether it's your personal skills, the country's domestic issues or foreign relations. These stats determine the story and future choices that you will get. Think carefully about your priorities as each decision has its trade-offs!

Your choices and stats will determine the story and the ending. Replay the game to discover all the different routes you can get! You can succeed or fail, be good or evil, have allies or enemies, allow freedom or become a dictator... The choice is yours.

You can expand your territory in a hostile way, or to increase your influence through soft power. Charm the key characters of each nation to win alliances (or make enemies). Romancing your rivals could also be a way of foreign policy! Your personal relationships can also affect the stats of your country, so be careful who you befriend and offend.

"I won't let him take over the world. I should be the one to do it first!"

🍁 Play as Lucena Sariez, whom the public has branded as a 'villainess'. She is skilled, ambitious, and resolute. Will you fix her reputation, or double down on the villainess route?

"You're... interesting."

❄️ The Duke of the North, Edgar Lareston-Hegel, was supposed to have a political marriage with Lucena, until he announced his surprising engagement to Rosalie. He is also vying for the throne, making him Lucena's nemesis. He is sharper than a winter icicle, but what's hiding behind his icy exterior?

🤍 Romanceable

"I was prophesied to help the next leader of Iriyn. Maybe that could be you, Lady Sariez."

🌸 Rosalie, born as a commoner, has become the popular 'saintess' and beloved idol of the public because of her soft personality and rare affinity for the newly-discovered Candentia energy. Even though she took Lucena's place, she secretly idolises Lucena. Now, she's only a budding spring flower in the court of Iriyn, but time will reveal her potential.

🤍 Romanceable

"We're really similar, Lucena! Does that infuriate you? Hehe~"

☀️ Aeriselle Andenia is like the summer sun of her homeland, Atissia. Sometimes warm, and sometimes the beginning of a wildfire. Depending on your choices, she could become a formidable ally or fatal enemy, or something in between?

🤍 Romanceable

There are plenty of other characters from various nations for you to meet. 

There are currently 4 romanceable characters: Edgar, Rosalie, Aeriselle, Helius (top row 2nd left)

🌟 Game functions

  • Save/Load slots

  • Skip, Back, and Dialogue History

  • Adjust the text speed and auto 'skip' settings

🌟 About the developer

I'm Lyyycaena, a solo dev! I couldn't find my dream game, so I decided to make it. Feel free to share any feedback about the game. My socials/email are on my website.

🌟 Want to join beta playtests?

You can sign up to my mailing list on my website! You'll get exclusive updates, bonus content, and invites to beta playtests when they happen.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu / SteamOS
  • Processor: 1 Ghz
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX or OpenGL compatible card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6-10.14
  • Processor: 1 Ghz, Apple Silicon or Intel
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX or OpenGL compatible card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game is non-notarized. May not work with 10.15 Catalina
